The '''Great crystal''' was a [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side artifact]] that imprisoned of the [[Soul/Legends|spirits]] of hundreds of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] kept within the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

==History==
A massive, pulsating violet [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], the Great crystal was located within the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and contained the [[Soul/Legends|spirits]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] who had been defeated by the powers of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Lost to memory after the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] abandoned Korriban, the souls within the crystal suffered an eternity of endless torment while the crystal remained intact.<ref name="TOTJ3" />

While seducing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]] brought him before the crystal as a final test of his commitment to the way of the Sith. After Kun commented on the horrible fate which had fallen on the Jedi Masters contained within the prison, Nadd decided to "liberate" the spirits, and Kun, from the light side. Nadd destroyed the crystal, annihilating the Jedi spirits within and causing an avalanche that would nearly kill the young Exar Kun.<ref name="TOTJ3" />
